name: Heel-to-Toe Walk
description: Walk in a straight line, the heel of one foot just in front of the toes of the other, as if on a tightrope: forward, or backward, putting each foot down with its toes just behind the other heel.
setup: Stand tall beside a wall or counter you can touch if you need to.
Arms out to the sides for balance.
cues: Heel to toe with each step.
Slow and steady; backward, reach back with your toes first.

prescription.note: Look ahead, not at your feet. Walk beside a wall or counter you can touch if you wobble.

keyframes.name: Right foot in front
keyframes.cue: Right heel just in front of your left toes.

keyframes.name: Left foot in front
keyframes.cue: Left heel just in front of your right toes.
